scope: Sentence segmentation and playback scheduling code only. No voice, speaker preset, model, audio recording, or lip-sync profile is included.

changes: Changed the relative type import to ./types.js.
Replaced @moeru/std errorMessageFrom with a standalone Error.message-only helper; queue, priority, events, and cancellation logic are preserved.
Adapted the punctuation, decimal separators, first-two-chunk latency boost, minimum 4/maximum 12 word targets, and Intl.Segmenter word counting to a synchronous push/finish interface.

Preserves exact text including whitespace, code, narrative, control characters, and original ellipsis spelling. No trim, narrative filtering, special-control execution, or source character replacement.
Replaced clustr and async streams with Intl.Segmenter grapheme segmentation and retained the unstable final grapheme across pushes.

Added a default 300 UTF-16-code-unit flush threshold; an indivisible grapheme may exceed it. Normal numeric runs move to the next chunk instead of splitting decimals or grouped numbers. Numeric runs longer than the threshold retain bounded grapheme splitting.
